Console connection

Use Neighborhood's default console, or choose a private LAN IP for blank-target connections.

Turning this off blocks uploads, launches, power, controller input and other console changes from paired browsers.

Command access

PC permissions will appear after pairing.

Admin overrides the write lock on this bridge PC until sign-out, console switch or bridge restart. File inspection, beta gates, recovery holds and private-data consent still apply. Phones cannot enable or use Admin.

Console profiles

Choose a saved console to fill the connection target. Each target keeps its own library and favorites.

Select a profile to edit it, or enter a new one.

Console controls

Commands use the connected Neighborhood console. Cold reboot restarts the console from a cold boot; an off console cannot be powered on through this connection.

A command response confirms acceptance, not completion. Reconnect after a reboot.

Xbox notification

Xbox notification

Send a message to the console through JRPC2. The reply confirms command acceptance; check the Xbox screen to verify display.

Connect a console to check JRPC2 notification support.

Xbox screen capture

Xbox screen capture

One still frame from XBDM. The image stays in this browser session and clears on disconnect. Capture after a notification to check what appeared on screen.

Connect a console to capture its screen.

Controller input

Sends a 160 ms press as user 0. A compatible Nebulah Companion module supplies a virtual controller when no pad is connected. Once used, cold reboot before removing the module.

Connect a console to check controller support.

Latest read

No read yet
Read a title address to see its bytes.
Edit four bytes in the running title

AppNET-style peek/poke. Read the address first, enter eight hex digits, review the current and new bytes, then confirm. A wrong edit may crash the game. Only the running XEX module is eligible.

Read memory first. This tool does not save or replay edits.

Reads are limited to 4–32 bytes within the active title module. Switching titles clears the watch and result. No memory bytes are saved to the library or activity log.

Confirm title memory edit

The console may stop or restart this game. Confirmation expires after 60 seconds.

Force release module?

A prior managed unload failed and this module remains listed. Force release resets its load count and calls the console unload function once more. Active hooks or threads may freeze the game or console. Save game progress first; a cold reboot may still be required.

360Stream live viewer

View the console stream over your local network. JPEG video appears after the console connects. Audio starts only when you enable it. Raw I420 video is not yet available in the browser.

Setup & troubleshooting

Place Xbox360Stream.xex and PERFORMER-AV.ini at the USB0:\ root. Set PC_IP to this PC's LAN IPv4, start the receiver, then inspect and load the XEX from Plugins while a game is running. Runtime loading needs JRPC2 and does not add a persistent boot plugin.

Listening on TCP 36000. If it stays here, check USB0:\PERFORMER-AV.ini, its PC_IP, and the PC firewall.

State: Stopped · 0 video frames · 0 audio packets

No console status yet.

Start the receiver, then load the root XEX to view JPEG video.

Before unloading with your console module loader, press Prepare module unload and wait for SAFE_TO_UNLOAD. Direct unload in Nebulah is paused for this beta. Closing the bridge during an active stream does not unload the console module.
